facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Act, 2022 (Act No. 11 of 2022, Chapter 44) is stated as commencing on 1 May 2023 under GN 326 of 2023, published in English as GN 395B on 13 June 2023, and applies to Mainland Tanzania and, for union matters, Zanzibar.

Section 6 of the Act establishes the Personal Data Protection Commission as a body corporate, with a seven-member Board appointed by the President and the Minister (s.8) and a Director General (s.11); the Act itself records no appointments.

systems.tiers: Mainland Tanzania; Zanzibar for union matters
